# BEFORE REPORTING:
If reporting a security vulnerability, please go [here](https://github.com/etangaming123/circlechiffon/security).

Check if the bot is online. This can be done with /cc-ping, as CiRCLE Chiffon's online status is hidden. If the /cc-ping command does not work, the bot is offline, and this bug should not be reported. 
If the command does work, you may report this bug.

# Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
## Example
✅Good:
CiRCLE Chiffon's /cc-login command doesn't pop out a modal for me to log in.
❌Bad:
CiRCLE Chiffon is broken

## Write the bug description below.

# To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior.

## Example
✅Good:
1. Use /cc-profile command
2. Check profile data
3. It doesn't match the data that I have on maimai DX NET! / Display doesn't look right!
❌Bad:
1. Use command
2. Command broken.

## Write the steps below.

# Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Example
✅Good: CiRCLE Chiffon should have given me x data, but it gave me y data instead.
❌Bad: it did not give me answer

## Write the expected behavior below.

# Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

# Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here.
